description: What a report shows in Report View and the JSON its look depends on, one record per report (ADR-023)

fields.label: Report
fields.description: The report these settings are for: one record per report

fields.label: Enabled in Report View
fields.description: Off: the standard report shows no button to Report View, and the Report View page says the report is not enabled

fields.label: Description
fields.description: A note for the people who maintain these settings

fields.label: What the report shows
fields.description: Every tool is on by default: the report then looks exactly as without these settings. A tool turned off is hidden everywhere (its button, tab, panel and menu entries) and a link that asks for it opens the default view.

fields.label: Row grouping
fields.description: The row-group bar, Group by in the column menu and the search options, dragging a column to group

fields.label: Group subtotals
fields.description: The subtotal rows of groups and of the report tree, and their switch

fields.label: Column groups
fields.description: The Column groups button and its dialog

fields.label: Pin columns
fields.description: Pin left / right / No pin in the column menu

fields.label: Density switch
fields.description: Comfortable / Compact in the page head (off: always comfortable)

fields.label: Search box
fields.description: The search and filter box of the toolbar

fields.label: Column filters
fields.description: The filter row under the column titles and Filter values in the column menu

fields.label: Value lists
fields.description: Filtering a text column by a list of its values (in the filter row, the filters panel and the search)

fields.label: Filters panel
fields.description: The Filters tab of the side panel

fields.label: Quick filters
fields.description: The report's quick filters (in the search options and the filters panel)

fields.label: Period field
fields.description: The single Period field of the criteria bar (off: the report's own date filters)

fields.label: Side panel
fields.description: The tool panels at the side of the grid (Columns and Filters)

fields.label: Columns panel
fields.description: The Columns tab of the side panel

fields.label: Pivot analysis
fields.description: The Pivot analysis view: its tab, the pivot mode of the columns panel

fields.label: Charts
fields.description: The Charts view

fields.label: Pages and print
fields.description: The Pages view and the Print button

fields.label: Excel export
fields.description: The Excel button (the server refuses the export too)

fields.label: Chart types
fields.description: The chart types the chart editor offers. A saved chart of a type turned off is dropped when the dashboard opens.

fields.label: Default view
fields.description: How the report opens when the link carries no view of its own. Column keys are the report's column fieldnames, one per line.

fields.label: Default view
fields.description: Empty: the table (or what the report's own configuration says)

fields.label: Group rows by
fields.description: Column keys, one per line, top level first

fields.label: Hidden columns
fields.description: Column keys, one per line

fields.label: Pinned columns
fields.description: Column keys, one per line (needs Pin columns)

fields.label: Row details
fields.description: The button in the first column that opens the whole row

fields.label: Offer the row's document
fields.description: When the row carries a document link: Open document and its standard print

fields.label: Document fields
fields.description: {"doctype_field": "voucher_type", "name_field": "voucher_no"}: the columns that hold the DocType and the document name

fields.label: Content
fields.description: Fields: every column of the row, labelled and formatted

fields.label: HTML template
fields.description: Jinja, rendered on the server in a sandbox. It reads row (the row's values, escaped), columns, report, filters, _() and format_value(value, fieldtype, options); nothing else

fields.label: Print format
fields.description: A Custom print format, rendered with data = the row

fields.label: Advanced: the report's JSON
fields.description: The parts of the report's shipped file (report_view/defaults). Empty: the shipped value is used. A list is merged with the shipped one: an entry with the same key replaces it, others are added. A shipped filter definition can never be removed or changed here (ADR-021).

fields.label: Report settings
fields.description: An object: tree, name_field, parent_field, initial_depth, export_hidden_cols (the report script's settings the server needs to export)

fields.label: Enrich rules
fields.description: A list of {"source_column", "link_doctype", "fields"}: the extra columns read from a linked DocType (ADR-011)

fields.label: Balance pairs
fields.description: A list of {"label", "debit_column", "credit_column"}

fields.label: Filter definitions
fields.description: A list of {"fieldname", "fieldtype": "Link" | "Dynamic Link" | "MultiSelectList", "options"}: the server checks these filters even when the browser drops them (ADR-021)

fields.label: Effective settings
fields.description: What the report reads: the shipped file with these settings over it

name: Report View Settings
